text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — prepping paid search + retarget for next Wed webinar (Mar 10). Need low-funnel scaling plan + clear lead routing. Goal: 600 registrants, CPA target ~$20.
Samir Patel: Love it. Proposed budget: $2k/day first 72h to seed, then $1k/day taper. Focus on high-intent keywords + sitelinks to register.
Jorge Alvarez: For retargeting, use 14-day site visitor audience and 7-day demo-clickers. Creative idea: 15s countdown + testimonial card. A/B CTAs: "Register" vs "Save your spot".
Kelly Tran: For inbound routing we should tag leads to SFDC campaign mar10_webinar and enrich with UTMs. I'll own the flow.
Maya Chen: @Kelly can you drop exact UTM mapping? also need confirmation on lead scoring threshold so routing rules are clear.
Kelly Tran: UTM example: ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=mar10_webinar&utm_content=vidA&utm_term={keyword} — we'll add &utm_creative={creative_id} too.
Kelly Tran: Lead scoring plan: >=50 pts -> SDR queue; 30-49 -> nurture + retarget sequence. I'll add automation: slack webhook to #sales-inbound on >=50.
Samir Patel: Creative refresh cadence: rotate assets every 48h for primary ad groups. Pause creatives that show >3% CPA delta vs baseline after 24h. Recommend bid cap on brand terms to avoid cannibalization.
AdOps Bot: AdOps deploy scheduled: campaign mar10_search seeded 2026-03-01T10:00Z. Template ID: ADOPS-4156.
Jorge Alvarez: Landing page variants: A = calendar widget (fast reg), B = gated slide deck (higher intent). Variant B historically lower CVR but better MQL rate.
Maya Chen: Anyone concerned about the heavy 72h seed spend? worried about overspend on low-quality traffic.
Samir Patel: We'll enforce CPA caps and conversion-value rules. Give the seed 72h then evaluate top-of-funnel metrics + quality.
Kelly Tran: I'll configure SFDC rules and add a webhook to post new MQLs into #sales-inbound with full UTM payload. Also will add a custom field for 'creative_variant'.
Maya Chen: Ok — action items: Samir sets daily budgets & automation rules; Jorge uploads creatives and labels them with creative_id; Kelly sets UTM + SFDC mapping + webhook; Maya owns the dashboard/reporting (Looker). Meeting Friday 09:00 to review first 72h. :thumbsup:
